canonical_title: Moonshot AI seeks Kimi K3 revenue-sharing deals with major US clouds
aliases: Kimi K3 Azure AWS Google Cloud revenue sharing
treatment: Repeat only if a cloud agreement is signed, commercial terms materially change, or regulatory action changes availability.
known_facts: Reuters reports Moonshot AI is in early-stage talks with Microsoft, Amazon and Google to host Kimi K3 with revenue sharing.
Moonshot is seeking up to 30% of K3-related service revenue; unresolved issues include revenue split, data access and token-usage auditing.
No agreement is certain and the companies declined or did not provide confirmation.
reinclude_only_if: A named US cloud signs or launches Kimi K3 under the proposed commercial structure.
Material final revenue-share, data-access or audit terms are disclosed.
US trade or regulatory action materially blocks or changes the arrangement.
notes: Commercial-distribution story distinct from the original Kimi K3 model release.
